work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter XCII approves and commends the Passi brothers’ Institute of St Dorothy; address, intitulation, body with Proverbs reference, blessing and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF18758–18758; the source dating clause at LF18833–18836 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petruin sub annulo piscatoris die decima nona maii millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo primo, pontifica- tus Nostri anno decimo primo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
